system.description:
You gain +10 to your [Special Attack] damage roll for all skills you possess with the [Support Song] tag (SR+1, maximum SR may be exceeded). [Trigger: Damage Roll] Once per scenario. A sinister flute that enchants and drives listeners to madness with its beautiful sound. Many talented musicians have played it, but all who owned it met unfortunate ends. Variants shaped like other instruments also exist.

Tough Tissue Membrane [Core Material] (680G) + Master's Instrument (540G) + [Magic Catalyst 20] (370G) ×5 + Crafting Cost (1450G)
